text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This summer is all about finding efficient running techniques—anything to help Ines make it through the Kikuka Sho without collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, apparently she's started a new side gig to fill her free time. She seems to be spending more and more time working…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she remains eager to find a safer running style, and approaches camp with unbridled enthusiasm. Let's make the most of this summer!
